full_prompt_en: A square exuberant decorative painting presents a dark narrow vase overflowing with vivid flowers against a turquoise ground patterned with large pale yellow spirals. The bouquet rises from the center and fans widely across the upper half. Rounded orange and golden blossoms sit at the left, a red layered flower and deep magenta bloom crowd the right, and a creamy white spiral-petaled flower occupies the middle front. Small orange berries branch outward toward the left edge; tiny white flowers and olive leaves fill gaps around the larger heads. The vase is almost black with a purple cast, placed slightly right of center on a horizontally striped teal tabletop. Thin brown stems show through its dark body, adding a subtle vertical inner texture. At its right sits a bright orange fruit and a few small yellow pieces. Two flat, brightly colored fish shapes appear along the lower surface, one gold near the vase and one red farther left, contributing a playful surreal note to the still life. The background is not a literal room: looping yellow and cream circles, curls, and broad turquoise strokes make a continuous decorative field behind the objects. Every flower is distinct yet painted with chunky, visible strokes; petal edges, seed heads, berry dots, and leaves are deliberately simplified into energetic marks. The color palette is saturated and warm against cool mint-teal: orange, crimson, scarlet, magenta, yellow, white, and dark green all repeat in different scales. Lighting is broad and even, with small highlights on petals and fruit but no strong cast shadow or deep spatial recession. The composition feels buoyant and slightly whimsical, held together by a dark central vertical anchor amid circular blooms, berries, and swirling ground patterns.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形热烈装饰性绘画呈现一只深色窄花瓶溢出鲜艳花朵，背后是带大片浅黄旋纹的青绿色底。花束从中央升起，在上半幅宽宽散开。圆浑橙色和金色花朵在左，层叠红花与深洋红花挤在右边，一朵奶油白螺旋花瓣花占据前方中部。小橙果枝向左缘伸出；细白花与橄榄绿叶填补大花头之间的空隙。花瓶几乎黑色，带紫调，放在略偏右的水平条纹青绿桌面上。细棕茎透过它的深色瓶身，增加隐约的内部竖向纹理。右边是一枚亮橙色果实和几块小黄色东西。两枚平面、鲜艳的小鱼形沿下方表面出现，一枚金色靠花瓶，一枚红色更靠左，为静物增加俏皮超现实细节。背景不是字面室内：黄与奶油色的圈、卷纹和宽阔青绿笔触在物体后形成连续装饰色域。每朵花都不同，却由粗壮可见笔触画成；花瓣边、花籽头、果点和叶子被有意简化为活跃记号。色盘以饱和暖色对照冷薄荷青：橙、绯红、猩红、洋红、黄、白和深绿都以不同尺度重复。光线宽广均匀，花瓣和果实上有小高光，却没有强投影或深空间退远。构图轻快而略带奇想，在圆形花冠、果点与旋转底纹之间由一条深色中央竖向锚点维系。
style_prompt_en: An exuberant decorative painting uses chunky visible strokes, simplified edges, and densely repeated circles to energize a shallow square space. A turquoise and mint ground carries broad cream-and-yellow spirals, while saturated orange, crimson, magenta, gold, and white clusters spread across the upper area. A narrow near-black vertical mass anchors the center, and a striped cool horizontal base steadies the busy arrangement. Small round dots and branching lines connect larger layered, petal-like shapes; color echoes recur at different scales to keep the abundance coherent. Edges are hand-painted and slightly rough, with thick opaque patches meeting thinner sketched marks. There is little deep perspective or directional cast shadow. Broad even illumination lets high-chroma warm colors pop against cool green-blue, while the dark anchor prevents the image from becoming weightless. The overall rhythm is circular, crowded, and playful, combining still-life solidity with an almost patterned surface.
style_prompt_zh: 热烈的装饰性绘画以粗壮可见笔触、简化边缘和密集重复圆形，让浅薄方形空间充满能量。青绿与薄荷底承载宽阔奶油黄旋纹，饱和橙、绯红、洋红、金与白色簇群在上部散开。狭窄近黑竖向体量锚定中央，条纹冷色水平底面稳定繁忙布局。小圆点与分枝线连接更大层叠、花瓣般的形状；不同尺度重复色彩回声，让丰盛仍保持一致。边缘手绘且略粗，厚实不透明色片遇到更薄的草绘记号。没有太深透视或定向投影。宽广均匀照明使高饱和暖色在冷绿蓝前跳出，深暗锚点则防止图像失重。整体节奏圆浑、拥挤、俏皮，将静物的实体感与近乎图案化的表面结合。
theme_en: A dark vase of vivid flowers with citrus and bright fish on a patterned tabletop
theme_zh: 深色花瓶插满鲜艳花朵，桌边有柑橘与亮色小鱼
name: Jennifer Lommers
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
